title: Kecksburg object

tellings.quote: uh there's something very bizarre came down there and I don't think it was a Soviet satellite.

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, tells of an event in 1965 in Kecksburg, a small town in Pennsylvania. Dolan says something very bizarre came down there and that he does not think it was a Soviet satellite, drawing on the work of a local investigator named Stan Gordon and a man named Frank Murphy. If true, it would mean an unknown object crashed on American soil.
